Definition: to equalize, i.e. straighten (intransitive or transitive); figuratively, to compose
BiblicalUsage: 1) to equalise, make straight, become straight; 1a) (Qal) to become straight; 1b) (Piel) to make straight, put straight, arrange in order, set in order
